thread:
Nina (PMM): Heads up 1: we need a compact copy pass for the three landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) plus launch posts, a short benchmark blurb for social, and the webinar promo kit. Timeline: draft by Wed, review Thu, go-live Mon.

Alex (Copy): I can knock out hero + subhead + 3 bullets per page. Thinking we keep a consistent pattern: capability line, economics line, trust/control line. Will post variants (concise + explanatory).

Rina (Design): Nice. Ill create two layout options: one focused on quick activation (trial-first) and one enterprise-first (demo-first). Need CTA copy options to test.

Sam (Growth): For routing, propose: 1) Trial signups -> Hosted SDR flow; 2) Demo requests with "qps estimate" -> AE; 3) Compliance checkbox -> Solutions Eng + Sales. Also want a webinar opt-in question: "Are you evaluating self-hosted or hosted options?" to split nurture.

Diego (SEO): Quick check 1: primary keyword should be "LLM inference platform" but longtail "low-cost LLM serving" in the hero subline. Ill build 3 title/meta pairs.

Alex (Copy): Draft copy samples (short):
Hosted: "Hosted API 1: integrate fast. Low-latency generation, SDKs, streaming, built-in quotas."
Dedicated: "Dedicated capacity 1: reserved GPUs, predictable throughput, SLA-backed latency."
Private: "Private deployment 1: VPC and on-prem options, KMS integrations, full data control."

Alex (Copy): CTA options: Hosted: `Start free trial`, Secondary: `Explore SDKs`; Dedicated: `Get capacity estimate`, Secondary: `View SLA`; Private: `Talk to sales`, Secondary: `Compliance brief`.

Rina (Design): For visual QA, prefer single-word CTAs where possible. Suggest `Try`, `Estimate`, `Contact`. Ill prototype both. Also will make social card templates for the benchmark blurb.

Nina (PMM): Benchmark blurb draft ideas (30-40 words for social + 1 short bullet list for webinar):
- Social: "See how Redwood reduces per-token cost with batching & quantization and keeps 95th-percentile latency under Xms in our live demo. Hosted, Dedicated, Private options covered."
- Webinar bullets: "1) Cost: batching & quantization impact; 2) Latency: median + 95th; 3) Reliability: multi-variant routing protects SLAs; 4) Ops: rollout & metrics"

Sam (Growth): Webinar plan: 30 mins. Promo schedule: 2 emails, 3 social posts (LinkedIn/Twitter), partner outreach. Add one paid ad CTA targeted at infra/platform engineers. Need final hero lines by Thu AM for the landing.

Diego (SEO): Ill also add an event schema for the webinar and test OG tags for the three pages. Will suggest canonical links to avoid duplicate content.

ops-bot: Reminder: Copy freeze for web assets on 2025-04-07 17:00 UTC.

Alex (Copy): Launch post hooks (short, two styles):
- Product-led: "Ship LLM features faster. Redwood offers Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployment modes with predictable performance—see benchmarks in our upcoming webinar."
- Enterprise-led: "Predictable inference capacity with SLAs and private deployments. Join our webinar for a cost + ops deep dive."

Nina (PMM): Good. Action items:
- Alex: full copy variants (concise + explanatory) for all three pages + two launch post hooks (due Wed 12:00).
- Rina: two layout mocks + social card templates + CTA experiments (due Wed 12:00).
- Sam: webinar registration copy, promo calendar, and routing map (due Thu EOD).
- Diego: SEO titles/meta, OG, and event schema (due Thu EOD).
- Ill collate benchmark numbers from eng and send a 1-slide summary by Wed EOD.

Alex (Copy): Ill also produce one longer paragraph per page for an FAQ section (re: model variants, quantization, SLAs).

Rina (Design): Can we pick a primary color accent for the enterprise cards? Leaning blue-green.

Sam (Growth): Quick question 1: will we gate the webinar recording behind a lead form? If yes, that affects how we route leads.

Nina (PMM): Yes, gate recording for non-customers. Recording access -> choose nurture path indicated during registration.

Diego (SEO): Noted. Ill add UTM templates for posts and include `utm_content` for the hero variant.

Nina (PMM): Thanks team. If no blockers, well reconvene Wed 10:00 for a 15-min copy + mock check. Ping here if you need to swap deliverables. :thumbsup:
